data.name: Adm360.RelFin.GuideSec3Body
data.value: Select the desired view in the tabs, apply the period and customer filters, and export to CSV when spreadsheet analysis is needed.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.GuideSec4Body
data.value: The reports use real historical costs and commissions effectively recognized by cash settlements.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.GuideSec5Body
data.value: Use the protected exports for accounting closing and payment reconciliation.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndComissoesEstorno
data.value: the row becomes ESTORNADA (preserved for audit; amber badge) and the footer total counts APROPRIADA only. Re-reversal restores APROPRIADA. Reversal is blocked inside a closed cash closing.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndComissoesFonte
data.value: adm360_comissoes_apropriadas — one row per effective receipt (invoice write-off), joining sale, user and write-off for audit.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndComissoesFormula
data.value: per write-off: round((sale accumulated received) × % ÷ 100, 2) − already recognized, minimum 0 (residue corrected on the last write-off).

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndDreConciliacao
data.value: consolidated = customers + "Not attributed", verified at generation time by re-aggregating the same sources; non-zero deltas appear as red badges instead of totals "that match by construction". Each row has a shortcut to the Sales tab (source records), filtered by customer when applicable.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndDreFiltros
data.value: accrual between start and end (inclusive); optional clienteId with cross-tenant rejection (400); always isolated by tenant.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndDreFluxoCaixa
data.value: recognizes on the document competencia — not on receipt/payment dates.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndDreFonte
data.value: revenue/cost side = adm360_vendas only situacao='CONFIRMADA', period over competencia; expense side = period adm360_titulos_pagar (on the invoice competencia; CANCELADO out). Sales without a name resolved in the tenant fall into the "Not attributed" bucket.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndDreFormula
data.value: Net Revenue = Gross − Deductions (discounts identified on the sale); Gross Result = Net − Realized Cost (value stored on the sale); Management Result = Gross − Estimated Commissions (stored on the sale) − Attributed Expenses (Σ valor_principal of period invoices).

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndDreLimitacoes
data.value: (1) expenses have no link to a commercial customer on this base (origem_tipo ∈ RECEBIMENTO_COMPRA/DESPESA_MANUAL/COMISSAO_VENDEDOR) — the entire total concentrates on the "Not attributed" row, and with a customer filter the row gets 0 (no attribution rule was invented); (2) commissions are the ones estimated on the sale, not what was actually paid in cash; (3) management basis (no accounting/ISC criterion, no currency conversion); (4) values stored on the document — no retroactive cost recalculation.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndMargemEstorno
data.value: does not change revenue, cost or estimated commission; only the "Commission Rec." column drops when a sale write-off is reversed.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndMargemFiltros
data.value: competencia between start and end (inclusive); optional clienteId (with cross-tenant rejection); no salesperson filter on this tab.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndMargemFonte
data.value: adm360_vendas only with situacao='CONFIRMADA', via valuation back to the source voucher.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndMargemFormula
data.value: Margin R$ = Net Revenue − Consumed Cost − Estimated Commission; Margin % = margin ÷ revenue × 100 (2 decimals; 0 when revenue = 0). Column "Commission Rec." = Σ APROPRIADA commissions (reversals already excluded in the database).

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndVencEstornoReceb
data.value: write-offs and reversals update valor_recebido/saldo_aberto/situacao on the invoice itself; the row reflects current state without duplication.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndVencFiltros
data.value: period over data_vencimento (inclusive); optional clienteId (with cross-tenant rejection); always isolated by tenant.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndVencFontes
data.value: adm360_titulos_receber × adm360_vendas — one invoice (installment) = exactly one row; name JOINs are 1:1, so footer totals sum each installment once (no multiplication). CANCELADO installments are out; QUITADO/PARCIAL appear as settlement history.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndVencFormula
data.value: data_vencimento < report date AND saldo_aberto > 0 (reference = moment of report generation), same rule as Accounts Receivable.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndVendasEstorno
data.value: does not change the sale row; the effect appears only in Commissions (status ESTORNADA) and in Cash Flow (compensating movement).

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndVendasFiltros
data.value: competencia >= start AND competencia <= end (inclusive); optional clienteId and vendedorId; always isolated by tenant — a clienteId from another tenant is rejected with an explicit error (400). Without dates: last 30 days up to today.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndVendasFonte
data.value: adm360_vendas (one row per confirmed sale), with customer/payer/salesperson names resolved via adm360_parceiros; historical records may point to the clinical table hospitais (name fallback) and an unresolved name becomes "Customer not identified".

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.IndVendasFormula
data.value: Net Total = gross − discount; Cost = Σ cost of lots consumed at valuation; Estimated commission = net × sale commission %. Values stored on the sale, no retroactive recalculation.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.MargemCardTitle
data.value: Management Result and Margin per Surgery

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.MargemVazia
data.value: No management result found in the period.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.SemSaldoVencido
data.value: No overdue balance at report date

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.VencidoTooltip
data.value: Due before report date with open balance

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.VencimentosCardTitle
data.value: Receivables by Installment — overdue evaluated at report date

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.VencimentosVazia
data.value: No installment due in the period.

data.name: Adm360.RelFin.VendasVazia
data.value: No sales found in the period.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.CanceladoEstadoTerminal
data.value: Auditable terminal state: this quote can no longer be transmitted, approved, or reversed (see event history).

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.GuiaCiclo
data.value: Quote cycle. Each button corresponds to a flow transition (generate estimate, approve response, transmit, reverse). The quote advances a stage only when the items are complete and the response approved.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.GuiaStatus
data.value: Internal status. The badge indicates the real stage of the record; financial movements generate traceable offsetting entries when the stage requires it.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.GuiaAssistente
data.value: AI Assistant. The optional panel generates a text analysis of the quote and its attached documents. It is supporting reading: accepting, rejecting, or transmitting remains a human decision, made through the corresponding button.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.GuiaDocumentos
data.value: Documents (XML). Fiscal attachments (NF-e/NFC-e/NFS-e) are validated on load; a format error is displayed without altering the rest of the document.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.GuiaAnvisa
data.value: ANVISA regulation. Each item with a related product shows the regulatory state of the offered material (registration number, not applicable, or pending). In the mapping modal, catalog selection shows that state for each candidate. On response approval, the state is frozen in the submitted version's snapshot — the submitted proposal does not change if the catalog changes later.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.PendingItemsBloqueio
data.value: Response approval and portal submission stay blocked until every item has a matching internal product or a non-fulfillment justification.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.PhJustSubstituicao
data.value: E.g.: Equivalent material authorized by ANVISA

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.PhMotivoNaoAtendimento
data.value: E.g.: Out of stock or discontinued

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.AnexosVazio
data.value: No attachments associated with this quote.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.OutboxAcaoNaFila
data.value: Next action: transmit the response (portal channel or manual export).

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.OutboxAcaoEnviando
data.value: Next action: await the portal return; interrupted sends are reconciled automatically.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.OutboxAcaoAceita
data.value: Final state: proposal accepted by the portal with registered protocol.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.OutboxAcaoRejeitada
data.value: Next action: review the rejection reason and retransmit.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.OutboxAcaoConfig
data.value: Next action: configure the provider account and retransmit.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.OutboxAcaoDesconhecida
data.value: Next action: explicitly confirm the retransmission to avoid duplicate sending.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.OutboxAcaoExportada
data.value: Next action: deliver the exported file to the client; retransmission preserves the original file.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.EstornoModalCorpo
data.value: The response returns to the queue (NA_FILA) without erasing the history: the current protocol and return message are preserved, and a new revision can be generated.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.EstornoPhJustificativa
data.value: E.g.: incorrect rejection by the portal — send a new revision with the corrected item

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.EstornoAjuda
data.value: Minimum 10 characters. Recorded in the audit trail along with the user who performed the reversal.

data.name: Adm360.CotDet.AiDescricao
data.value: Auxiliary reading over items, deadlines, and quote state. It does not replace approval, transmission, or any action in the module.

data.name: Adm360.Occ.Subtitle
data.value: Tracking of receiving deviations, documentary divergences and held lots (A12): open → in treatment → resolved → closed.

data.name: Adm360.Occ.EmptyState
data.value: No occurrences recorded at the moment.

data.name: Adm360.Occ.SecNovaDesc
data.value: Recording an occurrence does not remove stock (A12).

data.name: Adm360.Occ.ErrRequiredFields
data.value: Provide product, lot, location, deviation type and description, with quantity greater than zero.

data.name: Adm360.Occ.ErrCloseFields
data.value: Closing requires the items destination and a justification.

data.name: Adm360.Occ.FallbackTransition
data.value: The occurrence could not be updated. Refresh the page and try again.
